text.title: Inference Cost Unit Economics Worked Examples
text.summary: One complete report for two features (a support agent under its ceiling, a contract summariser over it with a retry loop and a long-context tail), with a note on each non-obvious value, and one bad report showing what the reviewer rejects.

section.title: Scenario
section.p: Acme runs two LLM features on the same Anthropic account: a support agent inside the self-serve plan and a contract summariser in the enterprise tier. Finance wants the Q2 margin per feature and a spend alert before the summariser is priced separately. The report covers 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-28.

example.title: Two-feature unit-economics report, June 2026
example.code: { "report_id": "support-agent-unit-economics-2026q2", "as_of": "2026-06-30", "author": "ml-finance@acme.example", "window": {"start": "2026-06-01", "end": "2026-06-28", "days": 28}, "token_source": "provider_usage", "headline_metric": "cost_per_successful_outcome", "price_sheet": [ {"provider": "anthropic", "model_id": "claude-sonnet-4-20250514", "sheet_date": "2026-06-01", "sheet_url": "https://www.anthropic.com/pricing", "input_price_per_1m": 3.0, "output_price_per_1m": 15.0, "cached_input_price_per_1m": 0.3, "discount_pct": 10, "discount_kind": "committed_use"} ], "features": [ { "feature_id": "support-agent", "success_definition": "ticket marked resolved by the customer within 24h of the last bot turn, no reopen within 7 days", "successful_outcomes": 41280, "cost_lines": {"input_tokens": 0.19, "output_tokens": 0.12, "cached_input_tokens": 0.02, "retrieval": 0.06, "tools": 0.05}, "cost_per_call": 0.04, "cost_per_outcome": {"p50": 0.31, "p95": 0.97, "mean": 0.44}, "retry_share_pct": 12, "first_action": "prompt", "revenue_basis": {"kind": "value_proxy", "derivation": "blended human-agent cost per resolved ticket from the Q1 support P&L, $4.10, used as value delivered"}, "revenue_per_outcome": 4.10, "gross_margin_pct": 89.3, "target_gross_margin_pct": 85, "cost_ceiling_per_outcome": 0.62, "tail_dominated": false, "daily_spend_alert": {"threshold_kind": "pct_over_trailing_7d", "threshold": 30, "wired_to": "grafana:alerts/llm-spend-support-agent"} }, { "feature_id": "contract-summariser", "success_definition": "summary accepted by the reviewer without edits to the obligations table", "successful_outcomes": 2140, "cost_lines": {"input_tokens": 1.84, "output_tokens": 0.41, "retrieval": 0.0, "tools": 0.09}, "cost_per_outcome": {"p50": 1.90, "p95": 11.60, "mean": 3.35}, "retry_share_pct": 22, "retry_cause": "JSON schema validation failures on the obligations table trigger up to 3 re-generations of the full summary", "first_action": "retry_policy", "revenue_basis": {"kind": "allocation_rule", "allocation_key": "share of enterprise-tier ARR by feature usage minutes"}, "revenue_per_outcome": 6.20, "gross_margin_pct": 46.0, "target_gross_margin_pct": 70, "cost_ceiling_per_outcome": 1.86, "tail_dominated": true, "tail_driver": "long_context", "daily_spend_alert": {"threshold_kind": "absolute_per_day", "threshold": 400, "wired_to": "pagerduty:llm-spend"} } ], "over_ceiling": [ {"feature_id": "contract-summariser", "gap_per_outcome": 1.49, "action_owner": "kim@acme.example"} ] }
example.note: `cost_per_call` 0.04 sits beside `cost_per_outcome.mean` 0.44: eleven calls per resolved ticket, which is the number finance would otherwise discover on the invoice (r-cost-per-successful-outcome).

`cached_input_tokens` is a fifth line because Anthropic bills cache reads at a tenth of the input price; the sheet pins that price with its date and the 10% committed-use discount so the next quarter's report can be diffed (r-four-component-decomposition, r-price-sheet-pinned).

The support agent's `retry_share_pct` of 12 stays under the 15% gate, so `first_action` may target the prompt. The summariser's 22% names its cause and is routed to `retry_policy`; a prompt change there would move nothing (r-retry-share-reported).

The summariser's p95 (11.60) is 6.1 x its p50 (1.90): `tail_dominated` is true and the driver is long context, read from the per-call log where the top 5% of sessions carry 150-page contracts (r-report-tail-not-only-mean).

Two different revenue bases, both stated: the support agent has no invoice line, so a value proxy with its derivation; the summariser is bundled into enterprise ARR, so an allocation rule with its key. The 46% and 89% are comparable only because the basis is written down (r-gross-margin-with-stated-revenue-basis).

Ceilings derive from the targets: 4.10 x (1 - 0.85) = 0.62 and 6.20 x (1 - 0.70) = 1.86. The summariser's mean 3.35 exceeds 1.86 by 1.49, so it appears in `over_ceiling` with a named owner, and its alert is absolute because the trailing baseline is itself over budget (r-cost-ceiling-and-runaway-alert).

example.title: What the reviewer sends back
example.code: { "report_id": "support-agent-unit-economics-2026q2", "as_of": "2026-06-30", "author": "ml-finance@acme.example", "window": {"start": "2026-06-26", "end": "2026-06-28", "days": 3}, "token_source": "estimated_from_chars", "headline_metric": "cost_per_call", "price_sheet": [ {"provider": "anthropic", "model_id": "claude-sonnet", "sheet_date": "2026-06-01", "input_price_per_1m": 3.0, "output_price_per_1m": 15.0, "discount_pct": 0} ], "features": [ { "feature_id": "support-agent", "success_definition": "ticket marked resolved by the customer within 24h of the last bot turn", "successful_outcomes": 41280, "cost_lines": {"llm": 0.33, "retrieval": 0.06, "tools": 0.05}, "cost_per_outcome": {"mean": 0.44}, "retry_share_pct": 40, "first_action": "prompt", "revenue_basis": {"kind": "allocation_rule"}, "revenue_per_outcome": 4.10, "gross_margin_pct": 89.3, "target_gross_margin_pct": 85, "cost_ceiling_per_outcome": 0.62, "tail_dominated": true, "daily_spend_alert": {"threshold_kind": "pct_over_trailing_7d", "threshold": 30, "wired_to": "grafana:alerts/llm-spend-support-agent"} } ], "over_ceiling": [] }
example.note: Validator output: `$.window.days: 3 violates minimum=7`, `$.token_source: must equal 'provider_usage', got 'estimated_from_chars'`, `$.headline_metric: must equal 'cost_per_successful_outcome', got 'cost_per_call'`, `$.features[0].cost_lines.input_tokens: missing required field`, `$.features[0].cost_lines.output_tokens: missing required field`, `$.features[0].cost_per_outcome.p50: missing required field`, `$.features[0].cost_per_outcome.p95: missing required field`, `$.features[0].revenue_basis.allocation_key: missing required field`, `$.features[0].retry_cause: missing required field`, `$.features[0].first_action: must equal 'retry_policy', got 'prompt'`, `$.features[0].tail_driver: missing required field`.

What the reviewer sees beyond the validator: `model_id` "claude-sonnet" is not a dated snapshot, so the 3.0 / 15.0 prices cannot be tied to a sheet (r-price-sheet-pinned); the 89.3% margin is computed on an allocation nobody named and would be challenged as arithmetic when the argument is about the key (r-gross-margin-with-stated-revenue-basis).
